in_sanskrit.name: अनन्थी

in_hindi.long_meaning: She who is endless, boundless, infinite

in_marathi.name: Ananthi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ananthi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ananthi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Anantha', which means 'endless', 'infinite', or 'boundless'. In Hindu mythology, Anantha is a serpent upon which Vishnu, the preserver god, lies in his cosmic form. The name Ananthi is thus a tribute to the infinite and eternal nature of the divine.
